injury_info.mechanism: Jonathan is unsure of the exact mechanism of his injury.  He felt the pain during the game but did not bring it to our attention until  after the game.

therapist_note.subjective: Pain is located along the area which he points at to be the L border of the inferior sacrum . He is unsure of what happened, he feels the pain when he is walking and L weight bearing and during late stance and early toe  off.
therapist_note.objective: Positive tenderness along inferior L border of the sacrum .  Full hip range of motion.  Pain with active hip flex in supine.  Pain with resisted hip internal rotation and  abduction.  Prominent L sacroiliac joint with leg length discrepancy L >R.
therapist_note.plan: Treat conservatively with moderate load and progressively advance treatment as tenderness decreases .
